appliedUpdates.description: Removed 138 remaining decorative ══ (U+2550) banner lines across 11 files that were missed by the original cleanup-comments-dead-code feature. The original feature only searched for // === and // ── patterns but not // ══ which is visually similar but a different Unicode character.

rejectedObservations.observation: Suggestion to update rust-refactor-worker skill search patterns to include all Unicode box-drawing characters
rejectedObservations.reason: The issue was fixed directly during scrutiny validation, so no skill change is needed. Future comment cleanup tasks are unlikely to encounter this same issue since all decorative banners have now been removed.
